name: epever-tracer
description: EPEver Tracer A/AN/BN series MPPT charge controller, RS-485 Modbus RTU (RJ45 port). Phase 1 bench meter B: PV-side measurements before the controller. Input registers, function 4. Serial 115200 8N1, default unit id 1.
notes: Addresses in decimal: 0x3100 PV voltage, 0x3101 PV current, 0x3102/0x3103 PV power (low word first), 0x3104 battery voltage, 0x3105 battery current, 0x330C/0x330D generated energy today (0.01 kWh), 0x3312/0x3313 generated energy total (0.01 kWh). The energy counters have 10 Wh resolution — useless for 5-minute intervals — so energy is integrated from the 0.01 W power register. Confirm register addresses against the controller's own manual before the first live read; series differ.
